label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (xss) alert-TP: Cookie values are user-controllable (set by clients via browser). Data flows from request.cookies -> TRUSTED_PREF cookie getValue() -> HTML encoded -> response.getWriter().println(). Although HTML encoding is applied, the sink outputs to HTML context (contentType=text/html) and the original data source is attacker-controlled. Encoding mitigates common XSS but does not guarantee complete protection against all payload variations or future vulnerabilities in the encoder. Resolved sink value: HTML-encoded cookie value from client-controlled source.

evidence.note: Cookie value extraction from client-controlled source flows to HTML response writer
